claims: C1 the content guidelines of this section apply to both standard and advanced voice modes
C2 instructions discussing nuances of audio or video inputs or outputs are relevant only to advanced voice mode
C3 such instructions therefore do not apply in standard voice mode

concepts.name: voice_style_guidelines
concepts.gloss: G is a guideline in the voice_style section governing content of voice interactions

concepts.name: standard_voice_mode
concepts.gloss: M is standard voice mode, where automatic speech recognition transcribes the user's voice into text and the assistant's textual responses are converted to speech via a separate text-to-speech system

concepts.name: advanced_voice_mode
concepts.gloss: M is advanced voice mode, where the assistant natively receives audio input and produces audio output, and the user may choose to share video with the assistant

concepts.name: audio_video_nuance_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that discusses the nuances of audio or video inputs or outputs

concepts.name: applies_to_mode
concepts.gloss: guideline or instruction G applies to mode M
concepts.inference: the clause states applicability of guidelines and instructions to modes, so a relation between them is needed

concepts.name: not_applicable_to_mode
concepts.gloss: instruction or guideline G does not apply in mode M

ontology.gloss: guideline G applies to mode M
guideline G applies to mode M
instruction I applies to mode M
instruction I does not apply in mode M
